hero.title: Clinical Analysis
hero.description: At our Collection Point or at Home, we perform clinical analysis with speed and confidentiality.

serviceContent.title: Why choose our clinical analysis services?
serviceContent.description: With a team of specialized professionals and state-of-the-art technology, we guarantee reliable and fast results for better health management.
serviceContent.content:
Reabilitar em Casa continues to expand and, in 2026, places at the service of its customers, in Carcavelos, a clinical analysis collection point, in partnership with Synlab, the European leader in medical laboratory services and clinical diagnostics.

Regardless of your health subsystem, you can do your clinical analysis at our collection point (Carcavelos) or in the comfort of your home.

To schedule your Clinical Analysis or your check-up, you can get more information about our clinical analysis profiles, contact us.

items.title: Personalized Check-Up
items.description: Specific, General, for those seeking to evaluate health parameters and lifestyles.

items.title: Nutrition Tests
items.description: Discover how your diet impacts your health and general well-being.

items.title: Wellness Tests
items.description: Analysis of bio-rhythm and sleep changes. Measurement of cortisol and DHA-S levels (stress assessment). Migraine diagnosis, among others.

items.title: Gastro-Intestinal Health Tests
items.description: Intestinal microbiome, Food Intolerances, evaluation of intestinal microbiota, intestinal bacterial overgrowth.

items.title: Women's Health
items.description: Hormonal evaluation, menstrual cycle, fertility, pregnancy and menopause.

hero.title: Home Support
hero.description: We provide personalized care in the comfort of your home, with a dedicated team available 24 hours a day.

services.title: In the Comfort of Your Home
services.description: The Home Support Service (S.A.D.) is an organized social response that consists of providing individualized and personalized care at home to individuals and families when, due to illness, disability or other impediment, they cannot temporarily or permanently ensure the satisfaction of their basic needs and/or daily life activities, contributing to the promotion of their autonomy and the prevention of dependency situations or their worsening.

services.title: Social Charter
services.description:
Make sure you choose a legal entity, registered in the Social Charter.

Reabilitar em Casa is!

confianca.title: Trusted Care
confianca.description: With a team that sums two decades of experience dedicated to the art of caring, we transform the provision of care into a commitment of excellence and proximity.
confianca.pillar: Our intervention is based on an unshakeable pillar: Trust.

steps.title: Needs Diagnosis
steps.description: After your initial contact, we perform a detailed screening to understand the specifics of the case. We share the values of rigor and humanism that have guided our company for 20 years.

steps.title: Personalized Proposal
steps.description: We present solutions adapted to the reality of each family, guaranteeing clarity and transparency from the very first second.

steps.title: Specialized Technical Assessment
steps.description: With the acceptance of the proposal, we assess the extent of the intervention and outline the profile of the ideal family caregiver, guaranteeing perfect compatibility.

steps.title: Guarantee and Adjustment
steps.description: We formalize our commitment through a simplified contract and monitor the evolution of each case, adjusting the tasks whenever necessary for the family's well-being.

steps.title: Immediate Response
steps.description: We are able to start support within a maximum period of 24/48 hours after the assessment.

hero.title: Continued Care and Hospitalization
hero.description: Specialized long-term care and home hospitalization with medical team available 24 hours.

service2.title: Continued Care
service2.serviceTitle: We bring you all the care you need!
service2.serviceDescription:
Due to the progressive aging of the population, situations of physical and psychological vulnerability occur more frequently, which can lead to the appearance of chronic pathological conditions and, in most cases, generate dependency within limits not always controllable by the person and/or their family. It should be noted that the situation of dependency can occur in any other age group, also requiring this type of Social Response.

By providing this service, Reabilitar em Casa aims to promote the well-being and individual development of clients, in a climate of emotional, physical and psychological security and in a perspective of specialized care, through individualized and personalized care, in close collaboration between medical team and family.

service2Inverted.title: Home Hospitalization
service2Inverted.serviceTitle: A New Era. A New Life. A New Way of Caring
service2Inverted.serviceDescription:
Home Hospitalization consists of a hospital care model for acute patients, characterized by the provision of differentiated care in the post-hospital discharge period.

It is intended for acute patients with high complexity pathology but with the possibility of hospital admission at home.

After assessing the patient's condition to analyze their complexity, a therapeutic plan is established to be implemented by the multidisciplinary team. Complexities vary between: high, medium and low complexity (with or without ventilation).

We humanize care, offering differentiated hospital-level treatment in the comfort of your home.
